grammar: Same as Hubble: one fluid, many sectors. Quiet/storm, slow/fast, ocean/air are interfaces, not extra laws.

predictions.name: usgs_comcat_gr_b_value
predictions.kill_if: USGS ComCat / ISC-GEM named global MLE b-value outside 0.90–1.10
predictions.what_it_is: Global magnitude-frequency slope b = φ − 1/φ = 1. Same acoustic counting as a Poisson process in the crustal fluid.
predictions.what_it_is_not: A date or place for the next M≥7 earthquake.

predictions.name: slow_fast_rupture_one_valve
predictions.sota_label: two unrelated constitutive laws (SSE vs EQ)
predictions.kill_if: community consensus that slow slip and fast earthquakes require two constitutive laws with no viscosity / rate-state continuum
predictions.future_survey: slow-slip moment-duration scaling literature (SSE vs EQ)
predictions.what_it_is: POOF = fast rupture (orifice open). SUCTION = slow slip (re-compaction). Same T3 valve, different viscosity. C10 at crustal scale.
predictions.what_it_is_not: A forecast of a specific slow-slip episode.

predictions.name: volcanology_gvp_residual_hold
predictions.future_survey: Smithsonian GVP + USGS volcano monitoring feeds
predictions.what_it_is: Eruption catalogs stay on the seed residual. VEI is a POOF-orifice class.
predictions.what_it_is_not: The date of the next VEI≥4 eruption.

predictions.name: swpc_kp_dst_classifier_hold
predictions.kill_if: space_weather or geomagnetism classifier panel exceeds 0.5% / 99.5% accuracy on SWPC refresh
predictions.what_it_is: Quiet vs storm are two sectors of the same solar-terrestrial valve (PRED-007 already locked ionospheric β).
predictions.what_it_is_not: A flare time-of-arrival for a named AR.

predictions.name: ndbc_fluid_tanks_residual_hold
predictions.kill_if: Between_Scale_Interconnects fluid_tanks_* channels exceed 0.5% on NDBC refresh
predictions.what_it_is: Same buoy pressure/SST/wind on Fluid, Ocean, Air folds. ENSO is κ not a new oscillator.
predictions.what_it_is_not: Next week's local forecast or the next El Niño onset date.

predictions.name: seismic_acoustic_prem_hold
predictions.kill_if: lithosphere vp/vs median channel exceeds 0.5% (deep PREM stays structural)
predictions.what_it_is: Mafic/lid Poisson ν=D_atomic/25. Deep phase changes are other interfaces.
predictions.what_it_is_not: A new radial Earth model replacing PREM.

predictions.name: solar_quiet_storm_two_sectors
predictions.sota_label: one solar-activity number for the whole cycle
predictions.kill_if: quiet-time and storm-time SWPC classes collapse to one residual sector on refresh
predictions.future_survey: NOAA SWPC F10.7 + Kp class products; solar cycle 26 onset (2030s)
predictions.what_it_is: Same grammar as Hubble: quiet and storm are different bubble-density sectors of one solar valve. Cycle 25 SSN is not relocked after the peak.

predictions.name: climate_station_and_marine_hold
predictions.kill_if: climate_observed or NDBC fluid-tank channels exceed 0.5%
predictions.future_survey: NOAA NCEI + NDBC continuous (pairs with PRED-054)
predictions.what_it_is: Weather/climate as Meteorology+Ocean+Fluid tanks, already green.
predictions.what_it_is_not: S2S ensemble beating ECMWF at week 3–4.
